name: Raptor Mastery
summary: In Stranglethorn Vale, Hemet Nesingwary sends you after Jungle Stalkers. Ten wary raptors stand between you and his finest hunt.

sections.title: A Cagey Quarry
sections.body: Hemet Nesingwary sends you after Jungle Stalkers, a harder quarry than the raptors you hunted before. They are wary and hard to track or kill. Find and fell ten in the jungle, then return to camp. Hemet will give you a lead on his finest hunt yet.

faq.answer: Hemet Nesingwary, the big game hunter, offers this hunt from his camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: What beast are you asked to track down?
faq.answer: You are asked to track and kill ten Jungle Stalkers, a wary and elusive kind of raptor.
Jungle Stalkers roam Stranglethorn Vale, especially north and west of the Gurubashi Arena.
This hunt follows the second stage of the Raptor Mastery trials, as Hemet Nesingwary continues through the local raptor breeds.

angles.text: As a hunter, tracking wary Jungle Stalkers tests your skill with prey and your marksmanship in the wilderness under Hemet Nesingwary's watch.
